developerData.about: Senior DLT Engineer & Blockchain Architect with {{years}} years of engineering experience, specializing in secure on-chain protocol design, smart contract architecture (EVM / Solidity / Casper / Hyperledger), and enterprise-grade banking & decentralized finance (DeFi) solutions. Combining deep Web3 domain expertise (consensus mechanisms, L2 rollups, RWA tokenization, Tatum/Fireblocks custody rails) with distributed systems engineering and AI-accelerated development practices. Active conference speaker, mentor, and Ethereum ecosystem educator.
